name: Video Notes Project
body:
> Project · 2026-10-22

# Summary
A project to transcribe Kim's course and training videos locally (free, with faster-whisper) and turn them into study notes. The `video-notes-agent` subagent runs it ([Claude Code Agents](lib:brain-claude-code-agents)): it transcribes each video, captures slide frames at scene changes, merges multi-part lessons and writes lesson notes, module summaries and a course overview that can go into the [Tag Marketing Vault](lib:brain-tag-marketing-vault).

# Current state (Oct 22, 2026)
- `Video Notes\Modern SEO\`: Module 1 (Lessons 1 to 5, Lesson 2 in several continuation parts), Module 2 (Lessons 1 to 4 on GBP audit, GBP landing page, citations and trust signals), Module 3 (Core 30 framework and gap analysis), Module 4 (Lessons 1 to 5 on client acquisition, pricing and outgrowing the methods), an `index.json` and a transcribe log.
- `Video Notes\tools\transcribe.py`: the transcription script.
- Finished Oct 22, 2026: all 4 modules transcribed (the first run logged 15 videos for Modules 1 to 3; Module 4 was added after), with lesson notes, module summaries and a course overview. Summarized in the vault as [Modern SEO Course](lib:brain-modern-seo-course) (4 module notes, 17 lesson notes).
